instruction: I went on a vacation trip to bali with my roommates. Share all of its photographs with them over email. You should send one email with everyone as recipients. Photographs can be found in my file system, and they should be attached as a zip file.
notes: Three apps are needed: phone to look up the roommates' email addresses (search_contacts with relationship=roommate; the result set is modeled as a single email-list object because the number of roommates is unknown), file_system to locate the Bali photographs directory (show_directory with substring 'bali', recursive=true) and compress it into a zip (compress_directory with default delete_directory=false so no existing file is removed and the only added file is the .zip), and gmail to send exactly one email to all roommates with the zip attached (send_email with attachment_file_paths=[zip] and file_system_access_token). Static init facts contacts-with, directory-matches and archive-of associate the runtime-discovered entities with their lookup keys; known-emails / known-directory / zip-ready / email-sent track progress. supervisor-complete-task carries the task-record objects (email list, zip) only to express the goal condition in its precondition; it has no API arguments since the task asks no question.

plan: (gmail-send-email roommate-emails subject-bali-trip-photographs body-bali-trip-photographs file-system-token bali-zip file-system-token)
